project.name: official_eval_gap_closure_detfix_t10_rl_accelerator_shell_8_000010
project.description: Build an 8-bit synthetic RL accelerator shell as a complete SR2FPGA Verilog RTL project. This is component topology t10_rl_accelerator_shell, difficulty tier T10. Use host_config_bank and sample_capture_stage feeding policy_value_core, then td_update_core and result_stream_stage. The design must implement this black-box behavior: configuration writes set weights, biases, alpha, and enable; sample tuples are captured, scored into a selected action and value estimate, updated through a TD datapath, and staged as a result stream with episode irq reporting. Keep rtl/top.v as the integration wrapper and keep each reusable component in a separate RTL file. Preserve these interface contracts: top.cfg_valid -> host_config_bank.cfg_valid; top.cfg_addr -> host_config_bank.cfg_addr; top.cfg_data -> host_config_bank.cfg_data; host_config_bank.cfg_ready -> top.cfg_ready; top.sample_valid -> sample_capture_stage.in_valid; sample_capture_stage.in_ready -> top.sample_ready; top.obs0 -> sample_capture_stage.obs0; top.obs1 -> sample_capture_stage.obs1; top.reward -> sample_capture_stage.reward; top.next_value -> sample_capture_stage.next_value; top.done_in -> sample_capture_stage.done_in; sample_capture_stage.out_valid -> policy_value_core.in_valid; sample_capture_stage.obs0_out -> policy_value_core.obs0; sample_capture_stage.obs1_out -> policy_value_core.obs1; host_config_bank.weight0 -> policy_value_core.weight0; host_config_bank.bias0 -> policy_value_core.bias0; host_config_bank.weight1 -> policy_value_core.weight1; host_config_bank.bias1 -> policy_value_core.bias1; host_config_bank.enable -> policy_value_core.enable; policy_value_core.out_valid -> td_update_core.in_valid; policy_value_core.value_estimate -> td_update_core.value_estimate; sample_capture_stage.reward_out -> td_update_core.reward; sample_capture_stage.next_value_out -> td_update_core.next_value; host_config_bank.alpha -> td_update_core.alpha; td_update_core.out_valid -> result_stream_stage.in_valid; policy_value_core.selected_action -> result_stream_stage.selected_action; policy_value_core.value_estimate -> result_stream_stage.value_estimate; td_update_core.updated_value -> result_stream_stage.updated_value; sample_capture_stage.done_out -> result_stream_stage.done_in; result_stream_stage.out_ready -> sample_capture_stage.consume_ready; result_stream_stage.result_valid -> top.result_valid; top.result_ready -> result_stream_stage.result_ready; result_stream_stage.selected_action_out -> top.selected_action; result_stream_stage.value_estimate_out -> top.value_estimate; result_stream_stage.updated_value_out -> top.updated_value; result_stream_stage.episode_done_out -> top.episode_done; result_stream_stage.irq -> top.irq. Include system_his.json, manifest.json, timing constraints, predicted QoR, and a bounded self-checking testbench that prints TEST_PASS only on success or TEST_FAIL on failure.
